transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been struggling with really severe mood swings. For about nine months, I felt incredibly energetic, hyperactive, and easily irritated, but for the last three months, I've completely crashed into a depression where I have no motivation or interest in anything.
During these times, or even when your mood felt more stable, did you ever hear or see things that others couldn't, or hold beliefs that others found highly unusual?
No, I've never seen or heard things that weren't there, nor have I had any unusual beliefs. It has really just been my extreme mood and energy levels swinging back and forth.
During those nine months when you felt highly energetic, did this lead to any major disruptions in your life, or did you ever need to be hospitalized because of it?

No, I was never hospitalized during that time, and I don't think it caused any major disruptions in my life. I was just constantly on the go and doing a lot of things, but it never got to the point of needing hospital care.
Did family members or friends comment on how different you were during that energetic period, or did you find yourself taking unusual risks or spending too much money?
I'm not really sure, and I don't recall my family or friends making any comments about it at the time. I also don't remember taking any unusual risks or spending too much money during those months.
During those nine months of high energy, did it affect your ability to do your job or schoolwork, or cause any serious conflicts in your relationships?

Actually, my high energy led me to take on far more work than usual and start multiple projects at once. However, I also became very easily irritated and would get angry over minor things, which caused quite a bit of tension and friction with the people around me.
Did the tension and friction you experienced lead to any serious consequences, such as losing a job, ending a relationship, or getting into physical fights?
No, it never got quite that extreme. I didn't lose my job, end any relationships, or get into any physical fights, even though things were definitely very tense and strained at times.

I'm not really sure, and I don't recall any specific changes in my sleep patterns during those nine months of high energy. I was so constantly on the go that I didn't really pay attention to how much I was sleeping.
Aside from those nine months, have you ever had another period of high energy or excitement that was much more intense or caused severe problems in your life?
No, I've never had another period of high energy or excitement like that. That nine-month stretch was the only time it has ever happened to me.
During those nine months when you had so much energy, did you feel like your thoughts were racing or moving incredibly fast, or did you find yourself talking much faster than usual?

I didn't really experience racing thoughts or feel like I was talking faster than usual during that period. Even though I was extremely active and had a ton of energy, my mind and speech didn't feel like they were speeding out of control.
During those nine months when you had so much energy, did you feel an unusual boost in your self-confidence, or feel like you were capable of things far beyond your normal limits?

No, I didn't really notice an unusual boost in my self-confidence during that time. I never felt like I had special abilities or could do things far beyond my normal limits. I just had a lot of physical energy to keep moving and working.
